intro.title: Build object diff utility
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a utility function that compares two JavaScript objects and returns the differences between them. You will learn how to use loops and conditional statements to iterate through object properties and identify changes. The main technologies involved are JavaScript objects, the `for...in` loop, and comparison operators. This exercise will help you understand how to work with dynamic data structures and create reusable code for data comparison tasks.
intro.usecase: Object diff utilities are essential in modern web applications for tracking changes in data structures. They're commonly used in form validation systems to detect which fields users have modified before submitting updates. In collaborative tools like Google Docs or Figma, diffs help synchronize changes between multiple users by identifying exactly what properties changed. Version control systems like Git use similar algorithms under the hood to compare file changes between commits. Developers also implement object diffs in state management libraries like Redux to optimize re-renders by determining which components need updates.
